classification: preregistered paper-execution data-freshness and dependency preflight; no performance or parameter test
candidate_context: R325 gold ballast passed return gates but failed R326 concentration; R327 top20 also failed. This preflight checks whether any forward signal could be generated from current inputs without stale-data leakage.

gates.D1_membership: HS300 cache as_of equals the current date, count is 300, and fetched_at is on the current date
gates.D2_equity_daily: both kline_daily and kline_daily_enriched have a partition on the current as_of date
gates.D3_alt_factors: ext_data/alt_hs300/timeseries has a partition on the current as_of date
gates.D4_industry_snapshot: industry snapshot file mtime date equals the current as_of date
gates.D5_financials: financials max period_end >= 2026-09-30 and max announce_date >= 2026-10-25
gates.D6_gold_etf: gold ETF qfq cache last date >= the current as_of date
gates.D7_factor_registry: custom factors uf_quality_value_defensive, uf_low_vol, uf_cash_quality resolve in the factor registry
gates.D8_feature_schema: latest enriched and alt partitions contain ma60 and all ext_alt_hs300 features required by A/B
gates.D9_strategy_files: both A/B strategy files exist and their SHA-256 values are recorded
gates.D10_fail_closed: if any upstream freshness gate fails, do not generate a paper target or order file

decision_rule: All D1-D10 pass -> ready_for_paper_signal_generation only. Any freshness/schema failure -> no_go_stale_inputs; no target file. This round does not change strategy rules and does not place orders.
known_limitations: A current industry snapshot has no historical vintage; file freshness does not make it PIT.
Financial period-end freshness is necessary but not sufficient for point-in-time publication timing.
A readiness pass would not authorize production; broker/order constraints still require a separate paper runner.
The A/B research evidence still uses R40 local data and current factor snapshots.
